options.content:
### Web-checker production
Read-only aggregates. Terminal attempt includes success or failure; overdue follows each schedule. Provider failures can warn while the worker stays healthy.

panels.title: Checker container / liveness
panels.description: Docker running/health only. Schedule-aware overdue is the worker-progress signal below; no providers are called.

panels.title: Scheduled jobs
panels.description: Enabled jobs with schedules only. Current expected operational baseline: 7; zero triggers a warning.

targets.expr: deployment_scheduled_jobs{job="smokemap-monitoring",host="jenkins",application="web_checker",environment="production",deployment="production"} and on(job,instance,application,environment,deployment) (deployment_signal_observation_success{job="smokemap-monitoring",host="jenkins",application="web_checker",environment="production",deployment="production",signal="worker_status"} == 1) and on(job,instance,application,environment,deployment) ((deployment_signal_timestamp_seconds{job="smokemap-monitoring",host="jenkins",application="web_checker",environment="production",deployment="production",signal="worker_status"} > time()-180) and (deployment_signal_timestamp_seconds{job="smokemap-monitoring",host="jenkins",application="web_checker",environment="production",deployment="production",signal="worker_status"} <= time())) and on(job,instance) (deployment_collector_fresh == 1)

panels.title: Overdue jobs
panels.description: Missing terminal attempts or age > max(3 × interval, 600) + 300 seconds. Production alert is critical.

targets.expr: deployment_overdue_jobs{job="smokemap-monitoring",host="jenkins",application="web_checker",environment="production",deployment="production"} and on(job,instance,application,environment,deployment) (deployment_signal_observation_success{job="smokemap-monitoring",host="jenkins",application="web_checker",environment="production",deployment="production",signal="worker_status"} == 1) and on(job,instance,application,environment,deployment) ((deployment_signal_timestamp_seconds{job="smokemap-monitoring",host="jenkins",application="web_checker",environment="production",deployment="production",signal="worker_status"} > time()-180) and (deployment_signal_timestamp_seconds{job="smokemap-monitoring",host="jenkins",application="web_checker",environment="production",deployment="production",signal="worker_status"} <= time())) and on(job,instance) (deployment_collector_fresh == 1)

panels.description: Consecutive failures ≥3. Warning is meaningful even when Docker health is green.

panels.description: Oldest max(last success, last failure) across scheduled jobs. Informational age: job intervals differ, so use the schedule-aware Overdue jobs card to assess timeliness. Missing attempts are not represented as zero age.

panels.title: Maintenance completion age
panels.description: Actual anchored completed log event, distinct from earlier backup manifest. NO EVIDENCE if absent; warns after 36h.

panels.description: Bounded manifest and matching regular file size. Created by online backup + integrity_check. No off-host or restored-product proof; Smokemap backup gate remains OPEN.
